name: Chris Duncan
summary: A Scottish lightweight (15-3; 6-2 UFC) from American Top Team, out of the Contender Series. He won four straight before Renato Moicano dropped and submitted him in R2 of their April main event, a fight Duncan entered as the betting favourite. His best weapon is his front headlock series: three of the four wins in that streak came by guillotine or anaconda choke (Sherdog).

how_they_fight.Striking: Busy and forward: about 5.0 significant strikes a minute at 48%, absorbing 4.3, with some power (0.56 knockdowns per 15). LowKick describes a pressure-heavy style built on forward movement and power combinations. Moicano out-jabbed him and dropped him with a left hook (Sherdog).
how_they_fight.Grappling: About 2.3 takedowns per 15. Recent submission wins: Bolaji Oki (R1), Jordan Vucenic (R2) and Terrance McKinney (anaconda choke, 2:22 of R1, a comeback win per BJPenn.com). He also controlled Omar Morales for about 6.5 minutes in a split-decision win.
how_they_fight.Defense: Sherdog's Ben Duffy notes his losses come after he gets clubbed and then finished: Viacheslav Borshchev (KO, R2, Contender Series 2021), Manuel Torres (sub, R1, 2024) and Moicano, who took his back after the knockdown and finished with a face crank at 3:14 of R2. Takedown defense is about 66%.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Steady over three rounds. Of his 15 wins, four are decisions; finishes: KO/TKO four times in R1, twice in R2, once in R3; submissions twice in R1 and twice in R2. All three losses were stoppages, in R1 (one) and R2 (two). He won three UFC decisions (Morales, Yanal Ashmouz, Mateusz Rebecki).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: A scrapper; Duffy says that mindset has 'only truly cost him twice'. Against Moicano a backward elbow he threw gave Moicano his opening (Sherdog).

patterns: Front headlock: guillotines and anacondas off opponents' shots and level changes
Gets clubbed and then finished in his losses
concerns: Chin against a big puncher: Dober has 17 KO/TKO wins
Seven months since a stoppage loss
keys_to_beat: Land a clean power shot early; his losses start with him getting hurt
Don't shoot into his front headlock

news.text: Dropped by a left hook and submitted by Renato Moicano (face crank, 3:14 of R2) in the UFC Vegas 115 main event.
BJPenn.com expected him to get an unranked opponent next after the loss.
